purpose: Route DeepSeek Harness (dsh) runtime work here, while keeping the four near-neighbours routing to themselves: multi-provider-ai (calling the DeepSeek API with no harness), claude-agent-sdk and google-antigravity-sdk (the peer vendor-SDK skills), ai-agent-development (runtime-agnostic agent architecture), and mcp-builder (building the MCP server rather than consuming one).

cases.prompt: help me build a coding agent with deepseek harness
set up a dsh headless profile for one-shot runs
wire an MCP server into deepseek harness so the model sees its tools
how do I register a new tool on ctx.tools in dsh
my dsh bundle patch is not taking effect, how do I inspect the plugin tree
call the DeepSeek chat completions API directly from python
build an agent with the Claude Agent SDK and a tool loop
build an autonomous agent on the Google Antigravity SDK
what memory architecture should my planning agent use
build a local MCP server with FastMCP that exposes three tools
